doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: Sri Chinmoy, meditation and taking care of the body
summary: He joined Sri Chinmoy's circle after Santana and McLaughlin; meditation and healthy living versus older musicians' habits.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Right. I don’t think so because I always took my time dealing with life. And then at one time I was with, you know I found out, I was with Sri Chinmoy because Santana and Mahavishnu, the guy who started Mahavishnu, John McLaughlin.

And they were with Sri Chinmoy. That’s where Santana gets all its spirituality from. And even Narada Michael Walden, they were all in there together. And I came in right after they left and that’s what I found out — you know meditation really works. And then Sri Chinmoy used to have vegetarian restaurants and health food stores. So you know I always tried to stay on top of taking care of yourself. Because you know musicians, right, if you study musicians back in the day now you say were they spiritual, they were spiritual, but man they used to stay out all night and drink and smoke cigarettes and all that stuff was tearing their bodies up and so I tried to be aware of that.
